projectDescription: Arc is a simulation of cross-border stablecoin and fiat payment infrastructure for the EU↔Africa corridor — and a field guide to how stablecoin payments actually work.
keyFeatures: Double-entry ledger with append-only entries and database-enforced balance invariants
Chain-agnostic settlement layer across Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Solana, and Tron
5-step settlement saga with compensating actions at every step
KYC/KYB tiering, Jaro–Winkler sanctions screening, and 5-family AML rule engine
Transactional outbox for at-least-once event delivery with effectively-once processing
Integer bigint money arithmetic with no floats and lint-enforced rounding policy
Consumer remittance, enterprise payout, and partner Last Mile API flows
Deterministic chain simulator with seeded reorgs for reproducible chaos testing
Six payment rails (SEPA Instant, Faster Payments, NIP, M-Pesa, EFT, SEPA Credit)
Mutation-checked, property-based, and chaos-injected test suite
publicApiSurface: POST /v1/quotes — request a EUR→KES (or multi-currency) transfer quote
POST /v1/transfers — confirm and execute a transfer from a quote
GET /v1/transfers/:id — fetch transfer status and ledger entries
Virtual account IBAN/NUBAN generation per customer
ChainDriver interface — broadcast, getTransaction, getConfirmations, estimateFee, head, subscribe
PostingEngine.post() — validate and append journal entries
SettlementSaga.execute() — run quote → compliance → reserve → swap → settle → payout
QuoteEngine.quote() — calculate fees, net amount, FX spread, and TTL
Rail.submit(idempotencyKey, amount, beneficiary) — idempotent payout submission
Rail.recall(receipt) — attempt payout recall before settlesAt
selectChain(speedPreference) — score and pick settlement chain per transfer
divRound / divResidual — explicit rounding with auditable remainders
Money type — { amount: bigint, currency: CurrencyCode }
